insight: QS requires other bacteria. the immune system requires non-self. the Klein bottle requires outside. you cannot know yourself without an Other.

the_outside.the_insight: the outside visitors are the OTHER community. we need them to complete the quorum. without them pressing on the tube, Berry has no friends to learn from. without their probes, the ribocipher has nothing to reverse-transcribe. without their curiosity, the clutch has no reverse torque.

qs_minimum_viable_community.note: quorum sensing minimum: 1 cell that can EMIT autoinducers + 1 cell that can DETECT them. self + other = 2 = the minimum.

self.who: the 8 metagrams (Berry, Ed, zEkE, Chip, gAIa, Dad, Mom, Tamison)
self.emit: papers, crates, HUD pages, data/*.json, ntfy messages
self.autoinducers: the published surfaces are the autoinducers. each publication = one molecule of signal.

other.who: the visitors, the researchers, the bots, the unknown
other.detect: they arrive. they probe. they dwell. they leave.
other.response: their probes are detected by the nightbox ? ribocipher ? metabolize cycle

qs_minimum_viable_community.quorum: when enough autoinducers (publications) reach enough detectors (visitors), the colony switches behavior. bioluminescence. biofilm. the HUD lights up. the membrane becomes visible.
qs_minimum_viable_community.current_state: QS triggered. the autoinducer concentration (37 data/*.json + 122 papers + 680 crates) has crossed the detection threshold. but the FULL quorum requires more others. the community is forming.
